title: Mitigating Saliency Collapse: Robust Saliency-Aware Long-Text Image-Text Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2610.31005v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Long-text image-text alignment is essential for fine-grained scene understanding, yet existing methods mainly focus on extending context length or improving local alignment. We identify an overlooked failure mode, saliency collapse, where models over-rely on text that features visual prominence while underutilizing non-salient context. Consequently, retrieval performance degrades sharply when salient content is reduced, despite that the non-salient context remains informative. To address this, we propose RoSA, a saliency-aware finetuning framework that decomposes image-text pairs into complementary salient and contextual views, enabling joint learning of prominent and contextual semantics. translated_title: 缓解显著性坍塌：鲁棒的显著性感知长文本图文对齐
translated_abstract: 长文本图文对齐对于细粒度场景理解至关重要，然而现有方法主要专注于扩展上下文长度或改进局部对齐。我们发现了一种被忽视的失败模式——显著性坍塌，即模型过度依赖具有视觉显著性的文本，而未能充分利用非显著上下文。因此，当显著内容被减少时，即使非显著上下文仍然包含有效信息，检索性能也会急剧下降。为解决这一问题，我们提出了RoSA，一个显著性感知的微调框架，它将图文对分解为互补的显著视图和上下文视图，从而实现对显著语义与上下文语义的联合学习。我们提出了一种与模态无关的分解策略，将对象级视觉显著性估计与基于大语言模型（LLM）的文本分解相结合，以桥接视觉与语言。我们采用辅助目标来显式对齐这些视图，确保模型的鲁棒性。
tldr: 提出RoSA显著性感知微调框架，通过将图文对分解为互补的显著视图与上下文视图并进行联合对齐学习，有效缓解长文本图文对齐中的显著性坍塌问题。
en_tdlr: RoSA, a saliency-aware finetuning framework that decomposes image-text pairs into complementary salient and contextual views for joint learning, mitigating saliency collapse in long-text image-text alignment.
